text:
I checked `chat-layout/requirements.md`, rewrote two things, and logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`. `text-check` flagged nothing, so both fixes come from reading it against the checklist.

- **Shown, not told:** the layout was only described in sentences, so I added a drawn sketch. It shows the plain assistant text on the left, a one-word owner pill and a long wrapped owner bubble on the right, and the 80% limit.
- **Short:** the "A sibling at work" paragraph ran about 60 words, so I split it into a short list.

I didn't look at any page, because the proposal is a markdown file with no `page.js`.

I wrote the review to `chat-layout/review/report.md` with verdict `fix`: four fixes and three notes, and no code edits.

- **Shots were missing:** `shots/` is empty and has no `layout.json`, so no layout, sizing, wrapping or spacing answer is measured. I judged from the builder's own `screens/`, which were taken from `127.0.0.1:62509`, not `monorepo.lew42.com` as the brief asked.
- **Live growth is unproven:** no shot or test shows a pill widening while words arrive, so requirement 2 is unmet.
- **Reply indent:** at 1920, V2 draws the reply "Hello! What would you like to work on?" about 200px further right than every other reply.
- **Stale readme:** `ux/Dictate/readme.md` doesn't mention the changed `Widget.css` or the shared `bubbles.css`.

The three notes cover narrower assistant wrapping than the owner pill, a duplicate faded preview above the V2 pill, and no index of the task folder.

I did not re-run the browser tests.

The review comes back as **fix**. One thing needs fixing and seven are small notes. The report is at `chat-layout/review/report.md` in the qf-1 worktree.

**The one fix:** `ext/Chat/doc/scroll.md` line 30 is out of date. It still says every bubble is `--chat-bubble` wide (85% of the column, at most 34rem). This change removed that token and that rule.

**The layout itself looks right in all three views.**
- Your messages are tinted pills on the right that hug their text.
- The assistant's replies are plain text on the left.
- All three views draw from the one shared file, `bubbles.css`.
- The new test shows your bubble widening as words arrive, then stopping at the cap.
- The two problems from the first review are fixed: one V2 reply sat about 200px to the right of the others, and V2 showed a faded copy of your words above the pill.

**Notes worth knowing:**
- **Screenshots aren't from `monorepo.lew42.com` as asked.** The six shots came from the worktree's own dev server. The builder's reason holds: the branch isn't on that host until it merges, and that host refuses a headless browser without the site key. Reshoot after the merge.
- **Nothing was measured.** `shots/` is empty again and there's no `layout.json`, because `Server/review.mjs` won't write its output into a worktree. That's a gap in the review tool, and every worktree review will hit it. I judged the builder's six screenshots instead.
- **The growth test stops short.** It doesn't cover the moment the growing draft is replaced by the real message. The draft also has a dashed border the real bubble lacks, which could shift the width by about 2px.
- **The test's V1 half takes a shortcut.** It edits an existing bubble's text instead of going through the path a microphone uses, so it proves the styling but not V1's live behaviour.
- **The new readme section has two slips.** The picture's caption says "the three views" but shows V3 only, and the two new bullets split an existing list in two.
- **Line spacing differs between views.** V3 replies have looser lines than V2's and a bigger gap above the play controls.
- **80% looks small at 1920.** The chat column is only about 630px wide with about 630px of empty page beside it, so "80%" is 80% of that column (a 499px bubble). That page width was there before this change.

I rewrote the chat-layout task's report text so the text check is now clean. I didn't open any page, so I haven't done the three-question look (status, what was asked, what was delivered), and the walkthrough's screenshot table is still broken.

- **Broken images:** `walkthrough.md` points at `screens/v*-360.png` and `screens/v*-1920.png`, but there is no `screens/` folder. The task has `shots/`, which holds only V2 and V3 at 1920. The V1 and V3 phone shots the table promises don't exist. I couldn't fix that here, so the mastermind owner needs to re-shoot or repoint them.
- **Walkthrough:** `node Server/text-check.mjs` flagged two long paragraphs and a word count over 500. I shortened the setup paragraph and turned the dictation-growth paragraph into three bullets.
- **Outcome:** it didn't list the owner's asks. I appended a new outcome line to `session.jsonl` with five ticked asks, each with proof beside it: pills that hug, live growth, plain assistant text, the shared cap, and bubbles keyed by message id. It is under the 120-word limit.
- **Ownership:** the chat-layout mastermind is dormant, so I made the edits myself and sent nothing to it.
- **Logging:** I logged one "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`.
